goal: Final visual-fidelity and coherence pass plus the end-to-end verification gate; converge output of all prior phases into a shippable, tested build.
summary:
Phase 6 (Polish & Verification) complete. All 4 steps done:

1. **Visual fidelity pass**: 10 Playwright visual-regression tests asserting glass blur (backdrop-filter) on menubar/dock/spotlight/control-center, squircle window corners, -apple-system font, wallpaper gradient, dock icon count. Manual inspection notes recorded in .kimchi/docs/visual-inspection.md.

2. **Appearance-mode propagation sweep**: 10 Playwright tests verifying Light/Dark/Tinted modes apply correct CSS classes, Reduce Transparency toggle works, both persist across page reload, glass surfaces have backdrop-filter in both light and dark modes.

3. **End-to-end persistence test**: 4 Playwright tests verifying notes, VFS changes, and settings all survive a full page reload via localStorage — including a combined test that creates data in all three stores and verifies all survive a single reload.

4. **Final build/lint/test gate**: All green — pnpm build (73 modules, 512ms), pnpm lint (no issues), 67 Vitest unit tests, 117 Playwright e2e tests. Total: 184 tests passing.
